Problem Statement:
A food delivery service calculates delivery charges based on the customer's distance from the restaurant.
Write a C program that calculates the delivery charge based on the distance (in km) entered by the user:
Distance <= 3 km: Free delivery
Distance > 3 km and <= 10 km: ₹10 per km
Distance > 10 km: ₹100 flat fee plus ₹8 per additional km beyond 10 km 
Input Description:
The input is a single numerical value representing the distance (in km) entered by the user. 
Output Description:
The output is the calculated delivery charge. 
Sample Input:
2 
Sample Output:
Delivery Charge: ₹0.00
